changeinfo.changes:
The following issues are addressed:
  • Minor changes to the logo.
  • Fixed an audio-related crash.
The following features are added:
  • At the end of a run, players can now obtain additional coins through in-app purchases.

The following issues are addressed:
  • Fixed Trophy issues related to the importation of save files from the previous version of Jetpack Joyride.
  • Fixed an abnormal program termination that occurred when playing for an extended time.
